analysis.rationale: Revenue grew 40% YoY, PAT surged 236%, and debt-equity ratio improved to 0.03. Strong operational performance and robust order book of 10.46 GW support positive outlook.
analysis.summary: Vikram Solar reported FY2026 consolidated revenue of ₹48,023 Mn, EBITDA of ₹9,166 Mn, and PAT of ₹4,704 Mn, with significant improvements in margins and key financial ratios.
